stories.title: On the streets of Paris, hearts were divided as France beat Morocco in the World Cup
stories.summary: France beat Morocco to advance to the World Cup semifinals. The match drew crowds to Paris' streets to watch on big screens. In a country with a large Moroccan diaspora, many hearts were divided.

stories.title: Wally Funk, who waited six decades to reach space, dies at 87
stories.summary: Pilot Wally Funk has died at 87. Denied the chance to become a NASA astronaut, she finally reached space at age 82 aboard a Blue Origin flight.

stories.title: Cyclospora outbreaks grow in the Midwest
stories.summary: Michigan reports 1,250 cases of cyclospora and CDC surveillance shows cases in 17 states. The CDC has initiated a traceback investigation, as the source is not yet known.

stories.title: Utah judge now considering evidence against accused killer of Charlie Kirk
stories.summary: A weeklong hearing to establish whether the accused killer of conservative activist Charlie Kirk can be taken to full trial ended today. There has been dramatic testimony.

stories.title: Novelist Tana French serves as literary guide for Dublin
stories.summary: Fiction provides it's own kind of travel — right from your couch. NPR's Mary Louise Kelly talks with Irish writer Tana French about her books and others' writing that immerse readers in Ireland.

stories.title: Trump dismisses election commissioners, his latest step to shape voting
stories.summary: President Trump has removed the remaining three members of the bipartisan U.S. Election Assistance Commission. Here's what it means.
